title: Max and Pajama & Hot Cocoa Day
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: It is a cold morning. Brrr!
Today is Pajama and Hot Cocoa Day at McKinley!
Max wears soft blue pajamas with little bones on them.
Lupe wears pajamas with stars. The teacher wears slippers!
Everyone laughs. School in pajamas is so silly.
Parent helpers bring cups of hot cocoa.
Max blows on the cup. Whoo! It is hot.
Max takes a sip. Yum! Now Max has a cocoa mustache.
The class reads a cozy book on the rug.
Max yawns a big bulldog yawn. Pajamas make Max sleepy!
